codes.VALIDATION: Some of the information is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
codes.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
codes.NOT_FOUND: We could not find that record.
codes.CONFLICT: That conflicts with an existing record.
codes.UNIT_ON_HOLD: This unit is on quality hold. Release the hold before moving, deriving, changing stage, shipping or destroying it.
codes.UNIT_NOT_ACTIVE: This unit can no longer be changed: it was destroyed, or everything of it was shipped.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
codes.MFA_REQUIRED: Enter your verification code to continue.
codes.MFA_ENROLMENT_REQUIRED: Administrator accounts must set up two-step verification before continuing.
codes.REAUTH_REQUIRED: Confirm your password to continue with this action.
codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That e-mail, name or password is not right.
codes.INVALID_CODE: That code is not valid. Check the code and try again.
codes.INVITE_INVALID: This invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask an admin for a new one.
codes.MFA_ALREADY_ON: Two-step verification is already on. Turn it off before setting it up again.
codes.MFA_NO_PENDING_SETUP: There is no two-step verification setup in progress.
codes.MFA_MANDATORY: Administrators must keep two-step verification on.
codes.INITIALS_INVALID: The code prefix must be 2 to 4 letters.
codes.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
codes.LOCATION_NOT_EMPTY: This location still holds {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}. Move them first.
codes.LOCATION_INACTIVE: New units cannot be placed in a retired location.

passwordIssues.containsUsername: The password must not contain your username.
passwordIssues.common: That password is too common. Choose something harder to guess.
passwordIssues.repetitive: That password is too repetitive. Use a longer passphrase.

network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

page.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
page.errorBody: The page could not be loaded. Nothing you did caused this, and no records were changed.

reasons.eventInFuture: The date cannot be in the future. Choose now or an earlier date.
reasons.eventBeforeRegistration: The date cannot be before the unit was registered ({registered}).
reasons.registrationInFuture: A unit cannot be registered with a date in the future.
reasons.activityInFuture: An activity cannot be dated in the future.
reasons.completionInFuture: The completion date cannot be in the future.
reasons.completionBeforeStart: The completion date cannot be before the start date.
reasons.estimateBeforeStart: The estimated end date cannot be before the start date.
reasons.gramsRequired: Enter how many grams of {unit} are shipped, and whether wet or dry.
reasons.countRequired: Enter how many are shipped from {unit}.
reasons.seedsRequired: Enter how many seeds of {unit} are shipped.
reasons.seedsMoreThanLeft: Only {left} seeds of {unit} are left; {shipped} is more than that.
reasons.outboundNeedsUnit: Choose each shipped line from inventory with “Add a unit from inventory”, so stock goes down with it. Only trim can be entered as a free line.
reasons.unitTwiceOnShipment: A unit can appear on a shipment only once.
reasons.flowerWeightRequired: Enter the wet or dry weight of the harvested flower when you register it.
reasons.noWetWeightToShip: {unit} has no recorded wet weight. Record a weight on the unit first, then ship.
reasons.noDryWeightToShip: {unit} has no recorded dry weight. Record a weight on the unit first, then ship.
reasons.moreThanLeftWet: Only {left} g (wet) of {unit} is left; {shipped} g is more than that.
reasons.moreThanLeftDry: Only {left} g (dry) of {unit} is left; {shipped} g is more than that.
reasons.driedShipsDry: {unit} has a dry weight: ship it by dry weight.
reasons.sampleNotApplicable: Samples are taken from flowers (by weight) or seed lots (by count).
reasons.sampleNeedsQuantity: Record the unit's weight or seed count before taking a sample.
reasons.sampleTooLarge: A sample takes part of the unit, not all of it ({available, number} available). Ship or destroy the unit instead.
reasons.wasteNotApplicable: Waste is recorded on flowers and harvested plants, by weight.
reasons.wasteNeedsWeight: Record the unit's weight before recording waste.
reasons.wasteTooLarge: Waste is part of the unit, not all of it ({available, number} g available). Record the destruction of the unit instead.
reasons.wasteInFuture: Waste cannot be dated in the future.
reasons.wasteBeforeLastEvent: Waste cannot be dated before the unit's last recorded event.
reasons.groupNotPlants: Only plant units are grouped, split or merged.
reasons.splitTooLarge: A split leaves at least one plant in the group ({available, number} in it).
reasons.mergeIntoItself: A group cannot merge into itself.
reasons.mergeNotAlike: Only groups of the same experiment, cultivar and growth stage can merge.
reasons.locationLoop: A location cannot be inside itself or one of its own levels.
reasons.tooFarBack: An event cannot be dated more than {days, number} days back (laboratory setting).
reasons.assigneeNotOnTeam: Assign a member of the experiment's team.
reasons.sopCodeTaken: That code is already used by another procedure.
reasons.capaOpen: Finish its corrective and preventive actions before closing the incident.
reasons.tissueNotApplicable: Tissue samples are taken from plants and cultures; flowers and seed lots are sampled by amount.
reasons.sopFileType: Attach the procedure as a PDF or Word document.
reasons.sopNoDraft: Draft a new version first: a version in effect never changes.
reasons.stageBackward: Stages only move forward: the unit cannot go back to an earlier stage.
reasons.weightRecorded: This weight is already recorded. Report the mistake as an incident: an administrator corrects it.
reasons.correctionReason: Say why the weight is corrected, in the note.
